title: 8A Dystopias and Utopias — Идиомы: будущее и общество

items.example: With cameras everywhere, Big Brother is watching you.
Social media created a brave new world.
Flying cars for everyone is just pie in the sky.
In a perfect world, nobody would go hungry.

items.idiom: have one's head in the clouds
items.example: Dreaming is fine, but don't keep your head in the clouds.

items.idiom: the light at the end of the tunnel
items.example: The peace talks are the light at the end of the tunnel.

items.idiom: the shape of things to come
items.example: This novel shows the shape of things to come.
Will the plan work? Only time will tell.
They had dreams and money to burn.
The film is full of doom and gloom.
Surveillance cameras are a necessary evil, some say.
Every crisis has a silver lining.
Hoping phones will disappear is wishful thinking.
Let's wait and see how the technology develops.
